newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat falls below 4,000 lire to three-yr low.
newsitem.headline: Fiat falls below 4,000 lire to three-yr low.

text.p: Shares in Italian car maker Fiat SpA tumbled 0.97 percent on Monday to 3,985 -- the first time they have sunk below 4,000 lire for nearly three years.

Dealers said concerns about the weakness of the Italian car market and the effects of the lira's strength on Fiat's overseas operations, which had weighed on the stock last week, were still discouraging buyers.
Fiat shares last fell below 4,000 in early December 1993.
Dealers said they expected buyers to emerge around the 3,970-3,950 mark.
Fiat was the second busiest stock in a limp Milan market, with 1.36 million shares changing hands. The Mibtel all-share index was down 0.61 percent at 9,782 by 0923 GMT.
Brokers MC-BBL, in collaboration with Aletti & C Sim, said in a note issued on Friday that Fiat shares had a potential upside of 20 percent to at least 5,200 next year.
